name: Payout speed
desc: Withdrawal times aggregated from public player reports and cited. A field test replaces this with the median of at least three withdrawals we time ourselves, at different sizes.

name: Bonus fairness
desc: Wagering, game weighting, max-cashout caps read line by line from the operator's own terms.

name: Crypto support
desc: Coins, chains, confirmation counts, who pays network fees — read from the operator's own help pages.

name: Trust & licensing
desc: Licence checked against the regulator's own register; complaint history checked against AskGamblers/Casino.Guru.

name: Game & RTP quality
desc: Live catalogue counts from the public lobby; the specific RTP version shipped is field-tested via RTP Watch as we cover each operator.

name: Support
desc: Response and resolution times aggregated from public player reports and cited. A field test replaces this with three tickets per operator, timed across time zones.
